name: DataGridPagination
purpose: Controlled grid pagination control for page size and previous/next display-row navigation.
knownLimitations: Display-row pagination only in this phase; generated group headers count as rows on the current page.
useWhen: Use when DataGridPaginationState, total row count, and updates are controlled by the consuming grid integration.
avoidWhen: Avoid assuming cursor-based or server pagination semantics; this control operates on the supplied display-row pagination state.
accessibilityNotes: The container is labelled "Pagination"; page-size selection has a visible "Rows per page" label and previous/next buttons have explicit aria-labels.
aiUsageNotes: Keep pagination controlled and supply totalRows; remember that current display-row pagination counts generated group headers as rows.
